---
title: "Make.com Workflows"
---

We offer seamless integration with Make.com for building powerful no-code workflow automations powered by AI agents. Connect TruGen.ai agents to your scenarios to automate conversations, trigger actions, process webhook events, and sync data across your tools effortlessly.

Bring AI agents into your workflows with TruGen.ai and Make.com to:

* **Create and manage AI agents** directly from your scenarios
* **Trigger workflows from webhook events** generated by agent conversations
* **Capture leads and qualification data** from inbound interactions
* **Sync notes, contacts, and conversation outcomes** with CRMs like HubSpot or Salesforce
* **Connect with thousands of apps and services** through Make.com’s automation ecosystem
* **Build end-to-end automations** for sales, support, recruiting, onboarding, and more

See the TruGen.ai Make.com integration documentation for setup instructions, available modules, and workflow examples.
